name: utuvo-todo-band
description: To-do band / 待辦條 — a line above the prompt with how many `- [ ]` items are still open in your TODO.md and the first one; a pane lists them all by section. Reads TODO.md in the project folder, else ~/TODO.md, or the file you set. Read-only. /todo-band off | on | list.

language.title: Language 語言
language.description: auto follows your system language (LC_ALL / LANG); zh-TW = 繁體中文; en = English.

file.title: To-do file 待辦檔
file.description: Markdown file to read, e.g. ~/Notes/TODO.md. Empty: TODO.md in the project folder, else ~/TODO.md. 空白＝先找專案資料夾的 TODO.md，再找 ~/TODO.md。
